This registry adapts existing source-backed records; it does not infer relationships from geographic proximity or similar names.

State association, registered headquarters and constituency are distinct from documented programme or asset coverage. Legacy Jammu & Kashmir tags may reflect pre-2019 boundaries; they are not assigned to Ladakh.
Paths traverse retained sourced relationships only. They demonstrate recorded connectivity, not causation, criminal guilt or influence.
Money retains currency, unit, accounting stage and period. No cross-stage, cross-currency or cross-population total is supplied.
Held records preserve missing sources, unresolved identities and claim-target responses without drawing dangling edges.
